app.name: upay Compass
app.tagline: Understand your money. Save with confidence.

common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.simulated_note: Simulated data. No real money is involved.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.intro: Set a monthly limit for a category. We alert you at your chosen level and again if you go over. Months follow Bangladesh time.
budgets.threshold: Alert me at {{pct}}% of the limit
budgets.threshold_hint: The small tick on each bar shows where the alert fires.
budgets.invalid: Choose a category and enter a limit above 0.
budgets.empty: No budgets yet. Add one to get alerts and improve your health score.

goals.title: Goals
goals.name: Goal name
goals.empty: No goals yet. Set one to start saving towards it.
goals.invalid: Enter a name and a target above 0.
goals.confirm_delete: Delete this goal and its history?
goals.status_none: Add money to see when you could get there.
goals.need_monthly: To finish by {{date}}, set aside about {{amount}} a month.
goals.simulated: Simulated: this earmarks money inside the demo, nothing real moves.
goals.roundup_body: Each payment you make is rounded up to the next ৳10 and the difference is set aside for a goal. You can turn it off or undo any round-up.
goals.roundup_need_goal: Create a goal first to use round-ups.
goals.roundup_total_one: Set aside by round-ups: {{amount}} from {{count}} payment
goals.roundup_total_other: Set aside by round-ups: {{amount}} from {{count}} payments

coach.title: Coach
coach.intro: Ask me about your spending, savings and goals. I explain your own numbers in plain words. Try one of the questions below.
coach.disclaimer: AI coach: educational guidance, not financial advice.
coach.failed: The coach could not answer just now. Please try again.
coach.rate_limited: You have asked a lot of questions in a short time. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
coach.declined: Without your consent the coach cannot see your numbers, so it stays off. You can change your mind any time by opening this tab again.
coach.suggest_why_overspend: Why did I overspend this week?
coach.suggest_can_afford: Can I afford ৳5,000 for a phone?
coach.suggest_improve_score: How can I improve my score?
coach.suggest_money_last: Will my money last this month?
coach.consent_title: Before you chat with the coach
coach.consent_sends: To answer, the coach is shown a short summary of your numbers:
coach.consent_item_numbers: Your wallet balance, income and spending by category for the last 30 days, budgets, health score and forecast.
coach.consent_item_goals: The names and progress of your savings goals.
coach.consent_item_never: It never sees your phone number, your name, who you paid, or your list of transactions.
coach.consent_how: Answers come from an AI model (OpenAI). The app calculates every number; the coach only explains them. It gives educational guidance only: no investment, loan or insurance advice. You can delete the conversation at any time.

learn.title: Learn
learn.progress_hint: Finish a short module to get started.
learn.not_found: We could not find that module.
learn.disclaimer: General education only, not financial advice.

login.invalid_phone: Enter a valid Bangladeshi mobile number.
login.otp_failed: That code is wrong or expired.
login.send_failed: Could not send the code. Please try again.

pin.title: Set an app PIN

onboarding.goal_optional: Optional. You can add goals later.

transactions.invalid: Enter a valid amount and details.

demo.loading: Loading transactions… this can take a few seconds.

score.title: Financial health
score.low_confidence: There is not much history yet, so treat this score as a rough estimate. It becomes more reliable after about a month of transactions.
score.no_data: Add some transactions first. We need them to work out your score.
score.not_enough_data: Not enough data yet, so this counts as a neutral 50.
score.detail_budget_ok: All your budgets are within their limits.
score.detail_buffer: Your wallet covers {{months}} months of essential spending (target {{target}}).
score.detail_stability: Your income varies by {{pct}}% between 30-day periods (lower is steadier).
score.moved_first: This is your first score. Changes will show up here next time.
score.moved_none: No change since the last score.
score.actions_none: Nothing to improve right now. Keep it up.
score.action_save_more: You saved {{ratePct}}% of your income. Setting aside about {{amount}} more each month would reach {{targetPct}}%.
score.action_set_budgets: Set a budget for the category you spend most on. Budgets are part of your score.
score.action_fix_budget_one: {{count}} budget is over its limit. {{category}} is {{amount}} over.
score.action_fix_budget_other: {{count}} budgets are over their limits. {{category}} is {{amount}} over.
score.action_build_buffer: Your wallet covers {{months}} months of essentials. Reaching {{target}} months needs about {{amount}} more.
score.action_smooth_income: Your income varies by {{pct}}% between 30-day periods. Setting some aside in better weeks smooths the lean ones.
score.how: The score blends four parts: savings rate (30%), budget adherence (25%), emergency buffer (25%) and income stability (20%), from your last 90 days. It is calculated by code from your own numbers, and it is for learning, not financial advice.

nudges.title: Alerts
nudges.empty: No alerts yet. We will tell you when you near a budget limit.
nudges.budget_threshold_body: You have spent {{spent}} of your {{limit}} limit this month.
nudges.budget_exceeded_body: You have spent {{spent}}, which is {{over}} over your {{limit}} limit.
nudges.overspend_body: You spent {{spent}} in the last 7 days, about double your usual {{average}} a week.
nudges.goal_behind_body: To reach it by {{date}}, set aside about {{amount}} a month.
nudges.goal_behind_body_none: Set some money aside to get back on track.
nudges.forecast_risk_low: Around {{day}} it could fall to {{amount}}, below your safety buffer of {{buffer}}.
nudges.forecast_risk_negative: Around {{day}} it could go below zero, down to {{amount}}. Your safety buffer is {{buffer}}.

forecast.title: Cashflow forecast
forecast.card_ok: Your balance looks safe for the next 30 days.
forecast.card_negative: Balance may go below zero around {{day}} (down to {{amount}}).
forecast.card_insufficient: Not enough history for a forecast yet.
forecast.insufficient: There is not enough transaction history yet to forecast honestly. Add or load a few weeks of transactions and check back.
forecast.no_data: Add some transactions first. We need them to build a forecast.
forecast.status_ok: Good news: your balance is expected to stay above your safety buffer ({{buffer}}) for the next 30 days.
forecast.status_low: Heads up: your balance may fall to {{amount}} on {{day}}, below your safety buffer of {{buffer}}. It first dips below the buffer on {{first}}.
forecast.status_negative: Warning: your balance may go below zero, down to {{amount}} on {{day}}. It first dips below your safety buffer of {{buffer}} on {{first}}.
forecast.low_confidence: There is not much history or no regular payments found yet, so treat this forecast as a rough guide.
forecast.chart_hint: Based on your regular income and payments plus your usual daily spending.
forecast.expect_hint: About {{income}} coming in and {{bills}} going out in regular payments over the next 30 days.
forecast.estimated_note: ~ means the amount varies, so we plan with a cautious estimate (lower for income, higher for payments).
forecast.backtest: Tested on your own recent history, this forecast was {{pct}}% closer to what really happened than a simple repeat-last-month guess (average error {{mae}} against {{naive}}).
forecast.how: A forecast is an estimate, not a promise. It is calculated by code from your own numbers and is for learning, not financial advice.

streak_7.title: 7-Day Streak
streak_7.how: Open the app 7 days in a row.

budget_master.title: Budget Master
budget_master.how: Keep every budget under its limit for a week or more.
